diagrams.title: One brain, many front doors
diagrams.caption: One brain, many front doors. Gradio, Slack and WhatsApp are just different ways to deliver `run_agent`'s text. This is the same idea as an MCP or A2A wrapper from Week 1: keep the agent, change the transport.
